title: GitHub PRs Widget Schema
description: Configuration schema for GitHub pull request tracking (review-requested, authored, mentioned)

githubToken.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
githubToken.description: Classic PAT with 'repo' scope (read-only). Required for PR search and private repos.

repos.label: Repositories (optional)
repos.description: Limit results to specific repos in owner/name format (e.g. octocat/Hello-World). Leave empty to search all accessible repos.

filterReviewRequested.label: Show Review Requested
filterReviewRequested.description: Show PRs where your review is requested

filterMentioned.label: Show Mentioned PRs
filterMentioned.description: Show PRs where you are mentioned

refreshInterval.label: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: How often to refresh PR data in seconds (default: 300 = 5 minutes)
